en.title: Counting Lamp Coverage at Points with Closed Intervals
en.description:
Each lamp covers a closed interval [left,right] on the integer number line. Given several query points, output how many lamps illuminate each point.

Standard input/output and this site's supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains m q (0≤m≤50000, 1≤q≤50000), followed by m lines giving left right (−10⁹≤left≤right≤10⁹); the last line gives the q query points (−10⁹≤point≤10⁹). The length limits are site supplements.
en.output: One line with q integers giving the number of covering lamps for each query point in input order, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: Sort all left endpoints and all right endpoints separately. The coverage of point p equals the number of intervals with left≤p minus the number of intervals with right<p.
hints: Sort all left endpoints and all right endpoints separately. The coverage of point p equals the number of intervals with left≤p minus the number of intervals with right<p.
